items.source: This class also supports an optional selector header on subscription messages with Spring Expression Language (SpEL) expressions evaluated against the headers to filter out messages in addition to destination matching. As of Spring Framework 6.1, the SpEL support is disabled by default, but it can be enabled by setting a selector header name.
items.translation: 该类还支持在订阅消息上可选的 `selector` 标头，使用 Spring 表达式语言 (SpEL) 表达式对标头进行求值以过滤消息，除了目的地匹配之外。自 Spring Framework 6.1 起，SpEL 支持默认处于禁用状态，但可以通过设置一个 selector 标头名称 来启用它。

items.source: By default the selector header name is set to null which disables this feature. You can set it to "selector" or a different name to enable support for a selector header.
items.translation: 默认情况下，选择器头名称被设置为 `null`，这会禁用此功能。您可以将其设置为 `"selector"` 或不同的名称以启用对选择器头的支持。
